capabilities: Turn list items into callouts via a configurable prefix character
Adjust callout padding via Style Settings
intentEvidence: Typing a configurable character at the beginning of a list item will turn the item into a callout
problem: Obsidian callouts only work as block-level elements, not on individual list items.

relations.evidence: The padding of the callouts can be adjusted using the Style Settings plugin.

summary: List callout formatter that turns list items into callouts when a configurable character is typed at the start of the item.
